Trump suggests Ukraine war deal could be close

Former U.S. President Donald Trump stated that Russia and Ukraine are going to "Make A Deal" soon, indicating both sides want the war to end. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that Kyiv and Washington want the war to end 'before winter.' Zelenskyy also mentioned a "positive and productive meeting" with President Trump in New York on Tuesday. U.S. Representative Walkinshaw expressed support for any meeting that could bring an end to the war.
